newsitem.title: USA: Seagull Energy exploring options for unit.
newsitem.headline: Seagull Energy exploring options for unit.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said on Wednesday that it had retained an investment banking firm to explore strategic alternatives regarding its Canadian operating subsidiary, Seagull Energy Canada Ltd.
"Investment interest in quality Canadian reserves such as ours appears to be higher at present than it has been in quite some time," said Seagull's chief executive Barry Galt.
In addition, the oil and gas company said its goal was to reach a decision on the unit no later than early autumn.
